# netbox_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists NetBox webhook objects (`/api/extras/webhooks/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_webhooks" "all" {}

data "netbox_webhooks" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "webhooks_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_webhooks.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/webhooks/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.

### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `additional_headers` (String) User-supplied HTTP headers to be sent with the request in addition to the HTTP content type. Headers should be defined in the format <code>Name: Value</code>. Jinja2 template processing is supported with the same context as the request body (below). When interpolating untrusted data (such as object attributes) into a header value, apply the <code>header_safe</code> filter to guard against HTTP header injection, e.g. <code>X-Object: {{ data.name | header_safe }}</code>. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `body_template` (String) Jinja2 template for a custom request body. If blank, a JSON object representing the change will be included. Available context data includes: <code>event</code>, <code>model</code>, <code>timestamp</code>, <code>request</code>, and <code>data</code>. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `ca_file_path` (String) The specific CA certificate file to use for SSL verification. Leave blank to use the system defaults.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.

- `http_method` (String) Http Method. Valid values: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.

- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `payload_url` (String) This URL will be called using the HTTP method defined when the webhook is called. Must be http:// or https://. Jinja2 template processing is supported (with the same context as the request body) for part or all of the URL.

- `ssl_verification` (Boolean) Enable SSL certificate verification. Disable with caution!. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `timeout` (Number) The maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a response before failing the request. Leave blank to use the system default (60 seconds).
